ExtraDock 4.3.1 – Stack 'Em, Tap 'Em, Time 'Em! 🗂️🥁

✨ New Widgets & Features

  • App Stack Widget: Group a set of apps or folders into a single expandable stack right in your dock — add items by drag & drop and launch them straight from the stack!
  • Metronome Widget: A dockable metronome with adjustable BPM and an audible click, perfect for keeping time without leaving what you're doing!
  • Clicker Widget: A simple tap counter that remembers your count between launches — handy for tallying reps, people, or anything else!
  • Reorder Your Docks: Drag docks into the order you want in the management window, and your arrangement is saved automatically!
  • Easier Custom Icons: Setting a custom icon is now discoverable directly from the dock items list!
  • Quicker Settings Access: Click anywhere on an item's row to open its settings!

🐞 Bug Fixes & Improvements

  • Docks Stay Put When Switching Spaces: Fixed several cases (especially on macOS 26.5) where a dock could briefly blink out when changing desktops, or stay missing on some Spaces until you restarted the app!
  • Fixed Notification Badge Crash on macOS 26 (Tahoe): Turning on notification badges no longer causes the app to quit unexpectedly!
  • Fixed Blank Window on Reopen: Clicking an app's dock icon after closing WeChat or WhatsApp with the red "X" now reopens a proper window instead of an empty one, matching the native Dock — focus behavior for apps like Claude, Chrome, and VS Code is unchanged!
  • Fixed Desktop Widget Layering: Desktop widgets now sit at the correct level relative to your docks!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
